reasoning_content: The npm error says it can't find the executable. Let me check if capacitor is installed.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check capacitor deps
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/client && npm ls @capacitor/core 2>&1")
print("Cap:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if we need to install globally
c.exec_command("npm install -g @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android 2>&1 | tail -5")

c.close()
EOF
